project.name: pgstat product family
project.codex_role: project manager + product manager + lead developer
project.operating_model: one product program, two independent runtime layers: pgstat Core and pgdbaagent

closure_policy.reason: A task can be suggested for closure by Codex after verification, but final done status needs explicit acceptance evidence or a documented not_required customer gate.

tasks.title: Promote next critical data-family contracts
tasks.problem: Many generated table/data-family contracts are still semantic scaffolds, so pgdbaagent could consume weak lifecycle evidence.
requirements: Review the highest-value remaining data families from docs/generated/contract-review-queue.md.
Confirm lifecycle semantics, schedule, retention, purge owner, partitioning, rollup, consumers, and security classification.
Promote stable decisions into docs/data-contract-registry.md or generator hints where appropriate.

acceptance_criteria.text: At least the next 10 high-value data families have reviewed semantic contracts.
Each promoted family has retention and purge behavior documented.
Generated contract-review queue reflects the reduced review gap after regeneration.

implementation_plan: Use contract-review-queue priority and consumer count to pick the next families.
Read migrations, collector repositories, PurgeEvaluator, PartitionManager, API routes, and UI references.
Update contract hints/manual registry and regenerate generated docs.
verification_plan: Review generated queue counts and promoted rows.
tasks.next_action: Promote the next batch of data-family contracts and reduce the generated review queue.

tasks.title: Promote next field contracts beyond the first 161
tasks.problem: 924 fields still need exact source/version/unsupported/consumer review.
requirements: Promote fields by evidence value, not by table order.
Start with fields required for Temp Spill, WAL Spike, Cache Hit, Vacuum Lag, Lock Wait, settings, and validation.
Every promoted field must state source expression, since_pg, unsupported behavior, sensitivity, and consumers.

acceptance_criteria.text: At least 100 additional fields are promoted or explicitly marked out of pgdbaagent scope.
Sensitive field policies are recorded for promoted fields.
Generated field-contract review count decreases after regeneration.

implementation_plan: Select fields from the first stable evidence packages.
Verify source SQL and PostgreSQL version matrix.
Update manual contracts/generator hints and regenerate docs.
tasks.next_action: Start after the next data-family contract batch is stable.

tasks.title: Add catalog metadata collection contracts
tasks.problem: pgdbaagent needs table/column/index/constraint context to reason about query plans, index proposals, and write risk.
requirements: Define source catalog queries for tables, columns, indexes, constraints, and relation ownership metadata.
Keep production collection read-only and version-aware.
Define retention, purge, and whether metadata is snapshot or slowly changing dimension.

acceptance_criteria.text: Capability card exists before implementation.
Storage and retention model are documented.
API/UI/pgdbaagent consumers are mapped.

implementation_plan: Write capability card.
Design schema and collector source queries.
Implement migrations, collector, API, and docs together.
verification_plan: api npx tsc --noEmit if API changes
tasks.next_action: Create capability card after contract promotion baseline.

tasks.title: Add safe planner stats metadata contracts
tasks.problem: Planner statistics are needed for index/query reasoning, but can expose sensitive distribution metadata.
requirements: Collect safe scalar metadata from pg_stats and extended stats without dumping sensitive values by default.
Classify histogram/MCV fields before any AI/export use.
Document unsupported-version and privilege behavior.

acceptance_criteria.text: Safe/blocked/redacted field policy is explicit.
Retention and row-volume budget are documented.
pgdbaagent evidence usage is documented before exposure.

implementation_plan: Define allowed scalar stats.
Exclude or redact raw value distributions unless explicitly approved.
Implement only after field security policy is accepted.

tasks.title: Add deploy/application event API
tasks.problem: Metric changes need deploy/event context to separate workload changes from database regressions.
requirements: Create an API for application/deploy events.
Events must be scoped to instance, database, service group, or application.
Retention, audit, and export behavior must be documented.

acceptance_criteria.text: Events can be written through a documented API.
Insights can correlate event windows later without schema redesign.
Retention and audit paths are implemented.

implementation_plan: Design event schema and API.
Add UI/import path only after API contract is stable.
Feed pgdbaagent evidence packages as contextual evidence.
verification_plan: ui npx tsc --noEmit if UI changes
tasks.next_action: Design after core contract review batch.

tasks.title: Add full lock graph snapshot
tasks.problem: Lock wait evidence needs blocker/waiter graph context, not just isolated wait rows.
requirements: Capture waiters, blockers, lock modes, relation/database context, and query identity where safe.
Represent lock graph snapshots in a way pgdbaagent can use for root-cause findings.
Document data sensitivity and retention.

acceptance_criteria.text: Lock graph evidence package can identify root blocker candidates.
Snapshot collection remains read-only and low overhead.
UI/API consumers and pgdbaagent usage are mapped.

implementation_plan: Define capability card and schema.
Implement version-aware collector query.
Expose API/UI only after contract is stable.

tasks.title: Define evidence package schemas v1
tasks.problem: pgdbaagent cannot reason safely until evidence packages are stable and field-backed.
requirements: Define JSON schemas for temp_spill_query_v1, wal_spike_query_v1, cache_miss_query_v1, vacuum_lag_table_v1, and lock_wait_v1.
Each evidence field must reference a source field contract ID.
Missing context and sensitivity policy must be explicit.

acceptance_criteria.text: Five evidence package schemas are documented.
Each package lists required and optional field contract IDs.
AI input boundaries are documented.

implementation_plan: Start with docs/schema only.
Use promoted contracts from P0-001/P0-002.
Implement builders only after schema review.
verification_plan: schema consistency review against generated field contracts

tasks.title: Define signal/finding/recommendation registry
tasks.problem: Reasoning is currently scattered between UI badges and design docs.
requirements: Create a global deterministic rule registry.
Separate UI hints from durable pgdbaagent signals.
Define lifecycle and status transitions for findings and recommendations.

acceptance_criteria.text: Signal, finding, and recommendation schemas are stable enough for v1 implementation.
At least the first Temp/WAL/Cache/Vacuum/Lock rules are listed.
Risk and confidence inputs are explicit.

implementation_plan: Document registry first.
Map existing UI badge heuristics to candidate signals where appropriate.
Implement code after schema acceptance.
tasks.next_action: Start after evidence package schemas v1.

tasks.title: Harden docs impact checker rules
tasks.problem: Local hooks enforce generated docs and broad manual docs, but project status and task lifecycle need stricter checks.
requirements: Validate project-board schema.
Generate project status from project-board.
Fail if done tasks lack verification or customer acceptance evidence.
Fail if too many tasks are in_progress.

acceptance_criteria.text: Project board validator runs from local hooks.
Generated project status is staged by pre-commit and checked by pre-push.
Project execution plan documents the workflow.

implementation_plan: Create docs/project-board.json.
Create generator and validator scripts.
Wire scripts into local hooks.

customer_acceptance.evidence: Governance automation task for local project control.

verification_evidence: Local hooks updated to validate board and reject project status drift.
Acceptance criteria are governance automation checks, customer gate not required.

tasks.title: Define validation target and result contracts
tasks.problem: Clone/staging validation needs structured target, job, and result contracts before pgdbaagent can compare before/after evidence.
requirements: Define user-provided validation target registry.
Define EXPLAIN and optional EXPLAIN ANALYZE capture contracts.
Define retention, audit, timeout, and concurrency policy.

acceptance_criteria.text: Validation target schema is documented.
Validation result schema is documented.
No automatic clone lifecycle is implied.

implementation_plan: Design contracts first.
Implement storage/API only after customer accepts boundary.
Keep production disconnected from validation execution.

tasks.title: Add project status view or docs link in admin UI
tasks.problem: Operators cannot currently see data coverage and project contract status from the product UI.
requirements: Expose project/contract status safely, likely as an admin link or read-only page.
Avoid leaking sensitive internal paths in public contexts.
Use generated project status as the source.

acceptance_criteria.text: Admin UI can surface project/contract status or link to docs.
No sensitive data is exposed.

implementation_plan: Decide whether this belongs in product UI or docs-only first.
Implement minimal read-only surface if approved.
verification_plan: ui npm run build if UI changes
tasks.next_action: Defer until P0 governance is stable.

tasks.title: Define AI/export redaction policy
tasks.problem: Sensitive fields need explicit allow/block/mask rules before AI or export usage.
requirements: Classify query text, application names, host metadata, settings, and event metadata.
Define defaults for UI, report, export, alert, and AI contexts.
Make pgdbaagent evidence builders enforce the policy.

acceptance_criteria.text: Redaction policy is documented.
Sensitive generated field count has an owner and decision path.

implementation_plan: Start with policy doc.
Add code enforcement when evidence builders are implemented.
tasks.next_action: Defer until promoted field set expands.

tasks.title: Add release checklist and upgrade impact template
tasks.problem: Enterprise releases need explicit migration, config, retention, compatibility, and rollback notes.
requirements: Create release checklist template.
Include migration/retention/config/security/UI/API impact sections.
Link checklist to project execution plan.

acceptance_criteria.text: Release checklist template exists.
Checklist is referenced by governance docs.

implementation_plan: Create docs/release-checklist-template.md.
Wire it into governance and project execution docs.
tasks.next_action: Defer until P0 governance is stable.
